scope: same Dev28 and frozen FOV, native pixels
boundary_envelope: new FP within Euclidean distance <=1 of A0 foreground; includes both lateral edge and tip extension; not proof of vessel thickening
novel_unsupported_axis: S(P_B) outside GT at distance >1 from S(P_A0); counts centerline positions, not anatomical branches
loss_of_unsupported_axis: S(P_A0) outside GT at distance >1 from S(P_B)
forbidden_inference: no branch anatomy or true background/GT-omission claims; no reconstruction of frozen endpoint primary/protection
